items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Major [illegible], that never got a chance to see his wife - he did that.

ctx.x: That's right. Major [illegible], that never got a chance to see his wife - he did that. The Captain of the

Company said, "I can't do nothing with this man," 'cause he was a frustrated little young drummer had been in the Army since he was 16 and he was about 25. He says, "What can I do?" and I says, "Nothing you can do." He said, "That man is crazy." He's got 2500 people in there and he's a commissioned officer out of Louisiana. But he got mad at Lester Young because he was married to a white woman. He said, "Who is that?" "That's my wife's picture." "She's a white woman." "Well, that's my wife." And Ken Bluett I had…
